sensor_classes.fail_safe: Geometry/twin state remains source-locked or stale; require survey/readback before promoting drift/as-built changes.
No strain-based structural inference; route to structural review.
No modal/dynamic health inference; use reviewed analysis/inspection baseline.
Cable state remains UNKNOWN; do not infer safe tension/sag. Requires semantic edge graph first.
Environmental state becomes UNKNOWN/STALE and any dependent response model must not update automatically.
Thermal/moisture state becomes UNKNOWN/STALE; no Solar Hull or glazing performance inference.
Drainage/moisture state becomes UNKNOWN; inspection/manual safe-state procedure required.
Electrical state defaults to unverified; protective system design governs, not twin assumption.
No protective-performance claim; follow designed inspection/testing protocol after event.
Protected-envelope state becomes UNKNOWN; no security/pressure adequacy inference.
Irrigation-dependent twin state becomes stale; system falls back to reviewed water-off/maintenance logic rather than assuming normal growth state.
Life-safety state is not inferred from missing data; physical alarm/egress systems and reviewed procedures remain authoritative.
Any dependent runtime fields without fresh, attributable data are marked stale/unknown and cannot be represented as current measured state.

runtime_state_machine.UNVERIFIED: No measurement-based promotion; show requirement/schema only.
runtime_state_machine.NORMAL: Internal update allowed only when calibration/source/applicability gates are satisfied.
runtime_state_machine.DEGRADED: Display degraded quality; route to review; do not silently retain normal trust.
runtime_state_machine.STALE: Force dependent value stale/unknown after its approved freshness rule is exceeded.
runtime_state_machine.OFFLINE: Force dependent value unavailable; safe-state/manual inspection rules govern.
runtime_state_machine.MAINTENANCE: Suppress operational interpretation and record service state.

public_candidate_fields: asset-level availability summary only after classification review
internal_fields: non-sensitive environmental and aggregate health states

Only then create LightSpeed adapters that consume classified, calibrated records.
